indicators.definition: Government respect for press and media freedom, ordinary people's political discussion, and academic and cultural expression.
indicators.nativeUnit: V-Dem interval index, low to high (0–1)
indicators.semanticLimit: This practice construct is broader than any one constitutional excerpt; it is not a measure of whether the text itself is strong.

indicators.definition: How often the high court avoids merely reflecting government wishes in salient cases regardless of its sincere view of the legal record.
indicators.nativeUnit: V-Dem ordinal response converted to interval by its measurement model
indicators.semanticLimit: Measures high-court decisional autonomy, not appointment design, lower courts, access to justice, or judicial capacity.

indicators.definition: Absence of registration fraud, systematic irregularities, government intimidation, vote buying, and election violence.
indicators.nativeUnit: V-Dem interval index, low to high (0–1)
indicators.semanticLimit: Election-year estimates are repeated within election-regime periods and may be backfilled before the first recorded election; a country-year is not necessarily a fresh election observation.

temporalBreaks.treatment: current harmonized backcast; never label values as originally published in a historical year
retain publisher repetition/backfill and disclose it; do not interpret each year as a new election
new release requires a new Civica release id and hashes; completed v1 remains immutable
